articles.title: Wall Street zigzags as Nvidia and other AI stocks keep swinging
articles.description: Wall Street is zigzagging as Nvidia and other AI stocks keep swinging on uncertainty about how much strength is left in their AI boom. The S&P 500 fell 0.1% Wednesday after flipping between gains and losses, coming off a four-day losing streak. The Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 575 points, while the Nasdaq composite rose 0.3%. Nvidia once again was at the center of the market’s moves. It initially jumped after delivering a better profit for the latest quarter than expected, but it quickly erased the gain and swung to a loss. Treasury yields eased after oil prices fell.
